definition: things that are made or grown to be sold
example: Mass production lowers the cost of certain goods.
exampleEs: La producción en masa reduce el costo de ciertos productos.
cloze: Mass production lowers the cost of certain ____.
note: 'Goods' is always plural in this sense: 'these goods are', not 'a goods'.

definition: an act of buying, selling, or moving money
example: Do you wish to make any other transaction?
exampleEs: ¿Deseas hacer cualquier otra operación?
cloze: Do you wish to make any other ____?

definition: a person with great knowledge who is respected
example: He is a respected authority in this field.
exampleEs: Él es una autoridad respetada en este campo.
cloze: He is a respected ____ in this field.
note: Not 'autoridad' as police or government here: it means an expert.

definition: the quality of acting in a sensible, adult way
example: Willingness to take responsibility is a sign of maturity.
exampleEs: La buena disposición a tomar responsabilidad es una señal de madurez.
cloze: Willingness to take responsibility is a sign of ____.

definition: at a time in the future that is not yet known
example: I'll have to tell you about it sometime.
exampleEs: Te lo tendré que contar algún día.
cloze: I'll have to tell you about it ____.
note: 'Sometime' (one word) means at some point; 'sometimes' means occasionally; 'some time' means a period.

definition: the act of eating or drinking something
example: It seems that the origin of the mutations is in the consumption of contaminated water.
exampleEs: Parece que el origen de las mutaciones está en la ingesta de agua contaminada.
cloze: It seems that the origin of the mutations is in the ____ of contaminated water.
note: Not 'consumición'; 'consumption' is the amount used or eaten, and is uncountable.

definition: a period when a country's economy gets weaker
example: He argued that the new policy was bound to drive the economy into recession.
exampleEs: Él reclamó que la nueva política estaba destinada a llevar a la economía a una recesión.
cloze: He argued that the new policy was bound to drive the economy into ____.

definition: how much work a person or company gets done
example: Some people listen to music when writing, but others say it hampers their productivity.
exampleEs: Algunas personas escuchan música al escribir, pero otras dicen que entorpece su productividad.
cloze: Some people listen to music when writing, but others say it hampers their ____.
note: Stress is on the 'tiv': pro-duk-TI-vi-ty.

definition: relating to money, especially in a country's economy
example: The manufacturing sector is a frenzy over the new monetary policy.
exampleEs: El sector manufacturero está frenético con la nueva política monetaria.
cloze: The manufacturing sector is a frenzy over the new ____ policy.

definition: likely to cause loss, danger, or problems
example: Don't you think doing that would be risky?
exampleEs: ¿No piensas que sería arriesgado hacerlo?
cloze: Don't you think doing that would be ____?

definition: the state of being unable to pay what you owe
example: After his bankruptcy, he wasn't able to get back on his feet.
exampleEs: Después de la bancarrota no pudo levantar cabeza.
cloze: After his ____, he wasn't able to get back on his feet.
note: Spelling: bankRUPtcy, with a 'p' that is easy to forget.

definition: the basic laws that say how a country is governed
example: The constitution of the country is very democratic.
exampleEs: La constitución del país es muy democrática.
cloze: The ____ of the country is very democratic.

definition: a possible situation that might happen in the future
example: You should always plan for the worst-case scenario.
exampleEs: Siempre debes tener previsto el peor de los escenarios posibles.
cloze: You should always plan for the worst-case ____.
note: Not a stage or a place: it means a possible situation.

definition: a light or sign that shows the state of something
example: The battery indicator light is showing that the battery is not getting charged.
exampleEs: El testigo de la batería indica que la batería no está cargándose.
cloze: The battery ____ light is showing that the battery is not getting charged.

definition: to put things into groups by type
example: The librarian classified the books according to subject.
exampleEs: La bibliotecaria clasificó los libros por tema.
cloze: The librarian ____ the books according to subject.

definition: the best or most suitable possible
example: Finding an optimal solution will take some time.
exampleEs: Encontrar una solución óptima demorará un tiempo.
cloze: Finding an ____ solution will take some time.

definition: very likely to happen or to do something
example: You are bound to regret it in the future if you are so lazy now.
exampleEs: Si eres tan perezoso ahora tu destino será lamentarlo en el futuro.
cloze: You are ____ to regret it in the future if you are so lazy now.
note: 'Bound to + verb' means almost certain, not 'obligado'.

definition: relating to managing and organizing a system or business
example: I made it so only root could access the administrative screen.
exampleEs: Lo hice de forma que solo un superusuario podría tener acceso a la pantalla administrativa.
cloze: I made it so only root could access the ____ screen.

definition: the ability to change or adapt easily
example: I'm fascinated by the extraordinary flexibility of this language.
exampleEs: La gran flexibilidad de esa lengua me fascina.
cloze: I'm fascinated by the extraordinary ____ of this language.

definition: to give official permission for something
example: Have you ever authorized me to leave early?
exampleEs: ¿Me has autorizado a irme temprano alguna vez?
cloze: Have you ever ____ me to leave early?
note: Spelling: American 'authorize'; British 'authorise'.

definition: an event that shocks people because it is wrong or dishonest
example: He had the courage to expose the scandal.
exampleEs: Él tuvo el valor de exponer el escándalo.
cloze: He had the courage to expose the ____.
note: Pronounced SKAN-dul; it is not 'escándalo' as loud noise.

definition: morally right and acceptable
example: Is it ethical to give him the interview questions in advance?
exampleEs: ¿Es ético adelantarle las preguntas de la entrevista?
cloze: Is it ____ to give him the interview questions in advance?
note: Stress on the first syllable: ETH-i-kal.

definition: a small ball of air or gas inside a liquid
example: At the end of the day, I relaxed with a wonderful bubble bath.
exampleEs: Al final del día me relajé con un maravilloso baño de burbujas.
cloze: At the end of the day, I relaxed with a wonderful ____ bath.

definition: to carry out a plan or task
example: Whose plan will be the hardest to execute?
exampleEs: ¿De quién será plan más difícil de ejecutar?
cloze: Whose plan will be the hardest to ____?
note: In business it means 'carry out', not 'kill'.

definition: a written promise to repair or replace a product
example: How long is the warranty for this device?
exampleEs: ¿Cuánta garantía me dan con este aparato?
cloze: How long is the ____ for this device?
note: Stress on the first syllable: WOR-an-tee. Often confused with 'guarantee'.

definition: based on numbers and data collected about something
example: I can provide you with some statistical predictions of expected revenues.
exampleEs: Te puedo ofrecer algunas predicciones estadísticas de los ingresos esperados.
cloze: I can provide you with some ____ predictions of expected revenues.

definition: a grid of numbers arranged in rows and columns
example: The matrix consisted of five rows and seven columns.
exampleEs: La matriz constaba de cinco filas y siete columnas.
cloze: The ____ consisted of five rows and seven columns.
note: The plural is 'matrices' (also 'matrixes').

definition: a willingness to accept special reasons or circumstances
example: The lawyer asked the judge to make allowance for the age of the accused.
exampleEs: El abogado le pidió al juez que sea indulgente por la edad del acusado.
cloze: The lawyer asked the judge to make ____ for the age of the accused.
note: Usually 'make allowance(s) for'; it can also mean money given regularly, like a 'travel allowance'.

definition: a piece of work given to someone to do
example: He gave us such a long assignment that we protested.
exampleEs: Nos asignó una tarea tan extensa que protestamos.
cloze: He gave us such a long ____ that we protested.

definition: to gradually collect more and more of something
example: He has accumulated quite a collection of books.
exampleEs: Él ha acumulado una colección bastante grande de libros.
cloze: He has ____ quite a collection of books.

definition: as the representative of someone else, in the phrase 'on ... of'
example: On behalf of my classmates, let me say a few words of thanks to you.
exampleEs: Déjame decirte unas pocas palabras de agradecimiento a nombre de mis compañeros.
cloze: On ____ of my classmates, let me say a few words of thanks to you.
note: Use 'on behalf of' (not 'in behalf'); it means acting for someone else.

definition: to use something fully, often in a clever or unfair way
example: Propaganda exploits the emotional registers of language in order to manipulate.
exampleEs: La propaganda explota los registros emocionales del lenguaje con el fin de manipular.
cloze: Propaganda ____ the emotional registers of language in order to manipulate.
note: Can be negative (use unfairly) or neutral (make good use of).

definition: a public sale where things go to the highest bidder
example: The magnificent stallion fetched a huge price at auction.
exampleEs: El magnífico semental alcanzó un precio enorme en la subasta.
cloze: The magnificent stallion fetched a huge price at ____.
note: Say 'at auction', not 'in auction'.

definition: expensive, or causing a lot of loss
example: Salt was a rare and costly commodity in ancient times.
exampleEs: Antiguamente la sal era una comodidad rara y costosa.
cloze: Salt was a rare and ____ commodity in ancient times.

definition: in many cases, or by many people
example: Methadone is commonly prescribed as a pain killer.
exampleEs: Con frecuencia, la metadona se prescribe como analgésico.
cloze: Methadone is ____ prescribed as a pain killer.

definition: better in quality than something else
example: Machines that his company produces are superior to ours.
exampleEs: Las máquinas que produce su compañía son superiores a las nuestras.
cloze: Machines that his company produces are ____ to ours.
note: Say 'superior to', never 'superior than'.

definition: a situation where there is not enough of something
example: We have an abundance of bread, but a shortage of wine.
exampleEs: Tenemos abundancia de pan, pero escasez de vino.
cloze: We have an abundance of bread, but a ____ of wine.
note: Say 'a shortage of', and do not confuse with 'shorts'.

definition: to officially say that something is not allowed
example: Smoking is prohibited in every section of the restaurant.
exampleEs: Fumar está prohibido en todas las salas del restaurante.
cloze: Smoking is ____ in every section of the restaurant.
note: Pronounced pro-HIB-it; 'prohibited in' means not allowed there.

definition: the unpleasant effects of stopping a habit or drug
example: Have you experienced withdrawal symptoms in the past?
exampleEs: ¿Has experimentado síntomas de abstinencia en el pasado?
cloze: Have you experienced ____ symptoms in the past?
note: Here it means drug or habit withdrawal, not just taking money out.

definition: the large entrance area inside a building
example: Can you wait for us in the lobby?
exampleEs: ¿Puedes esperarnos en el vestíbulo?
cloze: Can you wait for us in the ____?
note: A false friend risk: 'lobby' also means a group trying to influence politicians.

definition: to become smaller, especially after washing or heating
example: That material's going to shrink if it's washed.
exampleEs: Esa tela va a encoger si se lava.
cloze: That material's going to ____ if it's washed.
note: Not 'shrunk' in base form; past is 'shrank' or 'shrunk'.

definition: to give money to someone for a loss or harm
example: Victims have the right to be compensated for their damages.
exampleEs: Las víctimas tienen derecho de ser compensadas por los daños.
cloze: Victims have the right to be ____ for their damages.
note: Takes 'for': compensate someone for something.

definition: achieving a lot or giving good results
example: You should spend less time complaining and more time doing something productive.
exampleEs: Deberías pasar menos tiempo quejándote y más haciendo algo productivo.
cloze: You should spend less time complaining and more time doing something ____.

definition: the highest point of a mountain
example: We took a long hike up to the summit.
exampleEs: Dimos la gran andada para llegar a la cumbre.
cloze: We took a long hike up to the ____.
note: Also means a high-level meeting: 'a leaders' summit'.

definition: to do something good for someone who helped you
example: I only wish there was some way I could repay you.
exampleEs: Ojalá pudiera devolverte el favor que me hiciste.
cloze: I only wish there was some way I could ____ you.
note: Past tense is 'repaid', not 'repayed'.

definition: belonging to only one person or group
example: We have the exclusive right to sell them.
exampleEs: Nosotros tenemos el derecho exclusivo de venderlos.
cloze: We have the ____ right to sell them.
note: Pronounce the stress on 'clu': ik-SKLOO-siv.

definition: based on clear thinking and good reasons
example: From an objective viewpoint, his argument was far from rational.
exampleEs: Desde un punto de vista objetivo, su argumentación se alejaba de lo racional.
cloze: From an objective viewpoint, his argument was far from ____.

definition: exactly the same in every way
example: No two snowflakes are identical, or at least no one has found them yet.
exampleEs: No hay dos copos de nieve iguales, o por lo menos nadie los ha encontrado.
cloze: No two snowflakes are ____, or at least no one has found them yet.
note: Used with 'to' or 'with': identical to the original.

definition: the act of copying data from the internet to your device
example: The download speed is twice as fast as the upload speed on this network.
exampleEs: En esta red la velocidad de descarga es el doble de rápida que la velocidad de subida.
cloze: The ____ speed is twice as fast as the upload speed on this network.
note: As a noun, stress the first syllable: DOWN-load.

definition: the quality of being correct and free from mistakes
example: Check up on the accuracy of this article.
exampleEs: Verifica la veracidad de este artículo.
cloze: Check up on the ____ of this article.
note: Preposition: accuracy of the data, not 'accuracy in'.

definition: showing approval or agreement
example: I'm looking forward to receiving your favorable answer.
exampleEs: Espero con ganas a recibir su respuesta favorable.
cloze: I'm looking forward to receiving your ____ answer.
note: British spelling is 'favourable'.

definition: a person who acts in place of another person
example: He will be my deputy while I am away.
exampleEs: Él será mi suplente mientras esté fuera.
cloze: He will be my ____ while I am away.
note: Not 'diputado' in the political sense; here it means a stand-in.

definition: to take someone to court to get money or justice
example: We sued the insurance company because it violated the terms of our policy.
exampleEs: Demandamos a la compañía de seguros porque violó los términos de nuestra póliza.
cloze: We ____ the insurance company because it violated the terms of our policy.
note: Pronounced like 'su'; the past 'sued' sounds like 'sood'.

definition: a legal case brought to a court by one person against another
example: Despite my lawyer's doubts, I chose to press forward with the lawsuit.
exampleEs: A pesar de las dudas de mi abogado, decidí continuar con la demanda.
cloze: Despite my lawyer's doubts, I chose to press forward with the ____.
note: A 'lawsuit' is the case; do not confuse with 'law'.

definition: to fly high in the air without effort
example: The eagle soared majestically above the snow-covered peaks.
exampleEs: El águila se elevó majestuosamente por encima de los picos cubiertos de nieve.
cloze: The eagle ____ majestically above the snow-covered peaks.
note: Pronounced like 'sore'; also used for prices rising fast.

definition: existing or happening in many places or among many people
example: The use of this type of radio has become widespread.
exampleEs: Se ha divulgado mucho el uso de ese tipo de radio.
cloze: The use of this type of radio has become ____.
note: One word, no hyphen or space.

definition: a kind feeling or willingness to help others
example: The airline provided free accommodation to stranded passengers as a goodwill gesture.
exampleEs: La aerolínea ofreció alojamiento gratuito a los pasajeros atrapados como un gesto de buena voluntad.
cloze: The airline provided free accommodation to stranded passengers as a ____ gesture.
note: In accounting, 'goodwill' is also the value of a brand or reputation.

definition: the chance that something will happen
example: The likelihood of being attacked by a shark is very low.
exampleEs: La probabilidad de ser atacado por un tiburón es muy baja.
cloze: The ____ of being attacked by a shark is very low.
note: Say 'the likelihood of' + -ing, not 'likelihood to'.

definition: large machines used in industry or farming
example: The company asked the bank to loan them some money to buy new machinery.
exampleEs: La compañía pidió al banco que le prestara dinero para comprar maquinaria nueva.
cloze: The company asked the bank to loan them some money to buy new ____.
note: Uncountable: say 'new machinery', not 'a machinery' or 'machineries'.

definition: things that cure an illness or fix a problem
example: Garlic and onion are good remedies against the common cold.
exampleEs: Ajo y cebolla son buenos remedios contra el resfriado común.
cloze: Garlic and onion are good ____ against the common cold.
note: Stress the first syllable: REM-uh-dee. Plural is 'remedies'.

definition: using new and original ideas or methods
example: Campana creates innovative prosthetics for pets without limbs, and even for wild animals.
exampleEs: Campana crea prótesis innovadoras para mascotas sin extremidades, e incluso para animales salvajes.
cloze: Campana creates ____ prosthetics for pets without limbs, and even for wild animals.

definition: agreement with a rule, plan or instruction
example: I will sell the boat in accordance with your orders.
exampleEs: Venderé el barco según tus ordenes.
cloze: I will sell the boat in ____ with your orders.
note: Fixed phrase: 'in accordance with', never 'in accordance to'.

definition: going straight up and down
example: The chakras are all aligned in a vertical column along one's spine.
exampleEs: Los chakras están alineados en una columna vertical a lo largo de la columna vertebral.
cloze: The chakras are all aligned in a ____ column along one's spine.
note: Opposite of 'horizontal'.

definition: to make use of something for a purpose
example: Atomic energy can be utilized for peaceful purposes.
exampleEs: La energía atómica puede ser utilizada para propósitos pacíficos.
cloze: Atomic energy can be ____ for peaceful purposes.
note: Formal; in everyday English 'use' is more natural. Not 'utilizar' for every case.

definition: people who officially ask for a job or place
example: My first task was to screen out unqualified applicants.
exampleEs: Mi primera tarea fue descartar los candidatos no cualificados.
cloze: My first task was to screen out unqualified ____.
note: 'Candidato' = applicant for a job; 'candidate' is often someone chosen for a vote or exam.

definition: apart from each other, not together
example: Let's not weaken our endeavor by working separately.
exampleEs: No dispersemos nuestro esfuerzo trabajando separadamente.
cloze: Let's not weaken our endeavor by working ____.
note: Spelling trap: 'separately' has 'a' in the middle, not 'e'.

definition: regular payment to use a service or product
example: The subscription is worth it if you travel a lot.
exampleEs: El abono merece la pena si viajas mucho.
cloze: The ____ is worth it if you travel a lot.
note: Stress the second syllable: sub-SCRIP-shun.

definition: the act of carrying out a plan
example: A regional observatory will be directed to monitor the execution of the plan.
exampleEs: Un observatorio regional será dirigido para controlar la ejecución del plan.
cloze: A regional observatory will be directed to monitor the ____ of the plan.
note: In business, 'execution' means carrying out a plan, not only a punishment.

definition: the freedom to use something as you wish
example: I have very little time at my disposal.
exampleEs: Dispongo de muy poco tiempo.
cloze: I have very little time at my ____.
note: Fixed phrase: 'at my disposal'. Do not say 'on my disposal'.

definition: an official check to see if something meets standards
example: The building did not pass a fire inspection.
exampleEs: El edificio no pasó una inspección de incendios.
cloze: The building did not pass a fire ____.
note: Say 'pass' or 'fail' an inspection.

definition: the quality of being easily affected by or aware of others' feelings
example: His stern tone and loud voice belied his inner sensitivity and caring nature.
exampleEs: Su tono severo y su voz fuerte enmascaraban su sensibilidad interior y su naturaleza cariñosa.
cloze: His stern tone and loud voice belied his inner ____ and caring nature.
note: 'Sensitive' means easily hurt or aware of feelings, not 'sensible' (sensato).

definition: to stop being valid after a certain date
example: My driver's license expires at the end of this month.
exampleEs: Mi licencia de conducir expira a final de este mes.
cloze: My driver's license ____ at the end of this month.
note: Use 'expire' for documents; 'expirar' also means to die, but not here.

definition: done in an organized way following a fixed plan
example: Logic is a systematic method of coming to the wrong conclusion with confidence.
exampleEs: La lógica es un método sistemático de llegar a la conclusión incorrecta con seguridad.
cloze: Logic is a ____ method of coming to the wrong conclusion with confidence.

definition: a person who does not belong to a group
example: The easier it is for an outsider to suggest a change, the more volunteers you'll get.
exampleEs: Entre más fácil sea para una persona ajena sugerir un cambio, más voluntarios obtendrán.
cloze: The easier it is for an ____ to suggest a change, the more volunteers you'll get.
note: Stress the second syllable: out-SIDE-er.

definition: faults or flaws in a product
example: The product is guaranteed to be free from defects.
exampleEs: Garantizan que el producto se halla libre de defectos.
cloze: The product is guaranteed to be free from ____.
note: Noun: DEE-fect. Verb 'to defect' has stress on the second syllable.

definition: the line where the sky seems to meet the land or sea
example: The sun sank below the horizon and it got dark.
exampleEs: El sol se hundió bajo el horizonte y se puso oscuro.
cloze: The sun sank below the ____ and it got dark.
note: Stress the second syllable: huh-RY-zun.

definition: worth having or doing because it is useful
example: It would be highly desirable for you to come.
exampleEs: Sería de la mayor conveniencia que viniese usted.
cloze: It would be highly ____ for you to come.
note: Not 'deseable' as a person; 'desirable' means worth having.

definition: willing to give more than is expected
example: Wherever you go, you will meet people who are kind and generous.
exampleEs: Adondequiera que vayas, conocerás gente amable y generosa.
cloze: Wherever you go, you will meet people who are kind and ____.
note: Preposition: generous with (something) or generous to (someone).

definition: unfriendly and ready to fight or oppose
example: The police tried to separate the two hostile gangs.
exampleEs: La policía trató de separar las dos pandillas hostiles.
cloze: The police tried to separate the two ____ gangs.
note: Pronounce 'HOS-tl'; the final 'ile' is not said like 'file' in US English.

definition: a large round container for liquids
example: How many litres of oil are there in a barrel?
exampleEs: ¿Cuántos litros de aceite hay en un barril?
cloze: How many litres of oil are there in a ____?
note: Oil is priced per 'barrel', which holds about 159 litres.

definition: to pass something from one person to another
example: He has transmitted all his knowledge to his son.
exampleEs: Él le trasmitió todo su conocimiento a su hijo.
cloze: He has ____ all his knowledge to his son.
note: Double the 't' in the past: transmitted.

definition: a person who buys and sells goods
example: A retail merchant buys wholesale and sells retail.
exampleEs: Un minorista compra al por mayor y vende al por menor.
cloze: A retail ____ buys wholesale and sells retail.
note: Not 'mercader' only; in business it means a trader or seller of goods.

definition: relaxed and not following strict rules of style
example: If you're going to translate this sentence, make sure you use informal pronouns and conjugations.
exampleEs: Si vas a traducir esta oración, asegúrate de usar pronombres y conjugaciones informales.
cloze: If you're going to translate this sentence, make sure you use ____ pronouns and conjugations.
note: Opposite is 'formal'. Do not confuse with 'unformal'.

definition: to make tighter or stricter
example: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
exampleEs: Los negocios pequeños tendrán que apretarse el cinturón para sobrevivir.
cloze: Small businesses will have to ____ their belts to survive.
note: Idiom: 'tighten your belt' means spend less money.

definition: to press something hard to force liquid or soft material out
example: He squeezed the toothpaste out of a tube.
exampleEs: Él exprimió la pasta de dientes del tubo.
cloze: He ____ the toothpaste out of a tube.

definition: expecting good things to happen in the future
example: If I remember correctly, you were quite optimistic at that time.
exampleEs: Si no recuerdo mal, en esa época eras bastante optimista.
cloze: If I remember correctly, you were quite ____ at that time.
note: Use 'optimistic about' + noun, not 'optimistic of'.

definition: coming at the end; most important or basic
example: The ultimate purpose of all the arts is nothing other than entertainment.
exampleEs: El fin último de todas las artes no es otro que el entretenimiento.
cloze: The ____ purpose of all the arts is nothing other than entertainment.
note: 'Ultimate' does not mean 'último' in order (that is 'last'); it means final or fundamental.

definition: an official document or proof that shows who you are
example: A passport is a valid form of identification.
exampleEs: El pasaporte es una forma válida de identificación.
cloze: A passport is a valid form of ____.
note: Stress is on the 4th syllable: i-den-ti-fi-CA-tion.

definition: the place where people do their jobs
example: I owe my success to the fact that I've never had a clock in my workplace.
exampleEs: Mi éxito es debido al hecho de no haber tenido nunca un reloj en mi lugar de trabajo.
cloze: I owe my success to the fact that I've never had a clock in my ____.
note: One word: 'workplace', not 'work place'.

definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
example: Long after you've become inactive, your mistakes, if not corrected, will live on to mislead future users.
exampleEs: Mucho después de que te hayas quedado inactivo, tus errores, si no se corrigen, seguirán vivos para engañar a los futuros usuarios.
cloze: Long after you've become inactive, your mistakes, if not corrected, will live on to ____ future users.
note: Irregular: mislead, misled, misled.

definition: the edge of a settled area, where new land or ideas begin
example: Many families left to make a new life on the frontier.
exampleEs: Muchas familias se mudaron para comenzar una nueva vida en la frontera.
cloze: Many families left to make a new life on the ____.
note: In this sense it is the edge of settled land, not a border between countries ('border').

definition: to take hold of something quickly and with force
example: I seize the moment and turn it to my advantage.
exampleEs: Me apodero del momento y lo convierto en mi ventaja.
cloze: I ____ the moment and turn it to my advantage.
note: Spelling: 'ei' as in 'seize' (not 'ie').

definition: a number that shows part of a whole, such as 1/2
example: Any whole number can be written as a fraction.
exampleEs: Cualquier número entero puede ser escrito como una fracción.
cloze: Any whole number can be written as a ____.
note: Not 'fricción' (that is 'friction'). Stress on the first syllable.

definition: having a strong wish to succeed or achieve big things
example: Sometimes it's better to concentrate on a modest objective in order to achieve a more ambitious one.
exampleEs: A veces es mejor fijarse un objetivo modesto, para conseguir otro más ambicioso.
cloze: Sometimes it's better to concentrate on a modest objective in order to achieve a more ____ one.

definition: only and nothing else
example: This short play is solely made up of two short scenes.
exampleEs: Esta corta obra de teatro solo se compone de dos escenas cortas.
cloze: This short play is ____ made up of two short scenes.
note: 'Solely' means 'only'; it is not related to 'solo' (alone, 'on your own').

definition: a person whose job is to represent their country abroad
example: He was a famous poet and a competent diplomat.
exampleEs: Era un poeta famoso y un diplomático competente.
cloze: He was a famous poet and a competent ____.
note: Stress on the first syllable: DIP-lo-mat.

definition: a person who owns a property and rents it to others
example: The landlord told him to leave because he hadn't paid his rent.
exampleEs: El casero le dijo que se fuera porque no había pagado el alquiler.
cloze: The ____ told him to leave because he hadn't paid his rent.

definition: to put the parts of something together
example: It took me several hours to assemble it.
exampleEs: Me tomó varias horas armarlo.
cloze: It took me several hours to ____ it.
note: Also means 'to gather people'. Not 'asamblea' (that is 'assembly').

definition: to take in and reduce the force or amount of something
example: The car bumper absorbed some of the impact.
exampleEs: El parachoques absorbió parte del impacto.
cloze: The car bumper ____ some of the impact.
note: Pronounce the 'b' then 'z': ab-ZORB.

definition: a small device used to do math
example: Is it true that you calculated this without a calculator?
exampleEs: ¿Es verdad que calculaste esto sin una calculadora?
cloze: Is it true that you calculated this without a ____?

definition: things that block progress or make it difficult
example: We should move on, making the most of all the obstacles.
exampleEs: Debemos seguir adelante sacando lo mejor de todos los obstáculos.
cloze: We should move on, making the most of all the ____.
note: Use 'obstacle to' (not 'obstacle for') + noun: an obstacle to progress.

definition: a group of things tied or wrapped together
example: He went out with a bundle of clothes in his hand.
exampleEs: Salió con un bulto de ropa en la mano.
cloze: He went out with a ____ of clothes in his hand.

definition: not expected; surprising
example: I won't be able to meet you tomorrow because something unexpected has come up.
exampleEs: No podré juntarme contigo mañana porque surgió algo inesperado.
cloze: I won't be able to meet you tomorrow because something ____ has come up.

definition: the act of leaving a place, especially on a trip
example: Because of the bad weather, the plane's departure was delayed by two hours.
exampleEs: Debido al mal tiempo, la salida del avión se retrasó dos horas.
cloze: Because of the bad weather, the plane's ____ was delayed by two hours.
note: Use 'departure' for leaving; 'salida' also means 'exit', which is a different word.

definition: related to a difference or a rate of change in math
example: In general, little is known about nonlinear second order differential equations.
exampleEs: En general, poco se sabe acerca de las ecuaciones diferenciales no lineales de segundo orden.
cloze: In general, little is known about nonlinear second order ____ equations.
note: Used in math and finance; not the same as 'different'.

definition: people who give expert advice to someone
example: The role of the advisors is to assist the mayor in managing the city.
exampleEs: La labor de los asesores es ayudar al alcalde en la gestión de la ciudad.
cloze: The role of the ____ is to assist the mayor in managing the city.
note: Both 'advisor' and 'adviser' are correct spellings.

definition: to make someone want to do something, especially something unwise
example: I was tempted to skip class and go home early.
exampleEs: Tuve la tentación de saltarme la clase e irme a casa pronto.
cloze: I was ____ to skip class and go home early.
note: Say 'tempted to' + verb ('tempted to quit'). Pronounce the 'p': TEMP-tid.

definition: easy to see or very important
example: The repeated triplets are the most prominent motif in that movement of the symphony.
exampleEs: Los reiterados tresillos son el motivo más destacado en ese movimiento de la sinfonía.
cloze: The repeated triplets are the most ____ motif in that movement of the symphony.

definition: a mistake or weakness that makes something less perfect
example: I can't find a single flaw in her theory.
exampleEs: No puedo encontrar ni un solo error en su teoría.
cloze: I can't find a single ____ in her theory.
note: Say 'flaw in' something. Pronounced like 'floor', not 'flow'.

definition: the title of a news story, printed in large letters
example: I was furious when I saw a newspaper headline today.
exampleEs: Me puse furioso cuando vi un titular de periodico hoy.
cloze: I was furious when I saw a newspaper ____ today.

definition: including many different kinds of people or things
example: I love the diverse culture in this neighborhood.
exampleEs: Me encanta la diversidad cultural de este barrio.
cloze: I love the ____ culture in this neighborhood.
note: Stress on the second syllable: di-VERSE.

definition: despite what has just been said
example: Though he was poor, he was nonetheless happy.
exampleEs: Aunque él era pobre, de todas maneras era feliz.
cloze: Though he was poor, he was ____ happy.
note: Formal; one word. In emails, 'still' or 'even so' sound more casual.

definition: a machine or message that sends a copy of a document by phone line
example: What's the number of the fax machine in this hotel?
exampleEs: ¿Qué número tiene el fax de este hotel?
cloze: What's the number of the ____ machine in this hotel?
note: Pronounced 'fax' (like 'tax'), same spelling as Spanish but the 'a' is /æ/.

definition: going from side to side, parallel to the ground
example: In my opinion, a well-designed website shouldn't require horizontal scrolling.
exampleEs: En mi opinión, un sitio web bien diseñado no debería requerir desplazamiento horizontal.
cloze: In my opinion, a well-designed website shouldn't require ____ scrolling.
note: Stress on the third syllable: ho-ri-ZON-tal. The 'h' is pronounced.

definition: in a way that follows the law
example: I don't know how to legally get around those regulations.
exampleEs: No sé cómo sortear legalmente esas normativas.
cloze: I don't know how to ____ get around those regulations.

definition: to bring something back to life or health
example: How did you manage to revive these orchids?
exampleEs: ¿Cómo lograste hacer revivir estas orquídeas?
cloze: How did you manage to ____ these orchids?
note: Stress on the second syllable: re-VIVE.

definition: an arrangement to be somewhere at a certain time
example: I regret that a previous engagement prevents me from accepting your kind invitation.
exampleEs: Lamento que un compromiso previo me impida aceptar su gentil invitación.
cloze: I regret that a previous ____ prevents me from accepting your kind invitation.
note: False friend: here it is a scheduled commitment ('compromiso previo'), not a duty. It can also mean getting engaged to marry.

definition: a proud statement about how good you or your things are
example: His boast that he is the best pitcher is true.
exampleEs: Su alardeo de ser el mejor lanzador es cierto.
cloze: His ____ that he is the best pitcher is true.

definition: to talk with too much pride about what you have or can do
example: He boasts that he can speak six languages.
exampleEs: Él se jacta de que puede hablar seis idiomas.
cloze: He ____ that he can speak six languages.
note: Say 'boast about' or 'boast of' something; 'boast that' + clause also works.

definition: to make someone lose confidence or hope
example: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.
exampleEs: Él no se desalentará con facilidad, porque es un tipo duro.
cloze: He won't be easily ____, because he's a tough guy.
note: 'Discourage' is not 'descorazonar'; also used for 'to try to stop' something.

definition: in a very short time from now
example: The mayor will shortly announce his decision to resign.
exampleEs: El alcalde anunciará dentro de poco su decisión de abdicar.
cloze: The mayor will ____ announce his decision to resign.
note: 'Shortly' means 'soon', not 'brevemente' in the sense of 'briefly'.

definition: the power or events that seem to decide what will happen to you
example: She had no choice but to accept her fate.
exampleEs: Ella no tuvo más alternativa que aceptar su destino.
cloze: She had no choice but to accept her ____.
note: Not 'fecha' (date). 'Fate' sounds like 'fait' and means destino.

definition: seeing and accepting things as they truly are
example: He's realistic and doesn't believe in the possibility of miracles.
exampleEs: Él es realista y no cree en la posibilidad de los milagros.
cloze: He's ____ and doesn't believe in the possibility of miracles.

definition: a large building where trips by plane, bus or train begin and end
example: Go out of the terminal and turn right.
exampleEs: Sal de la terminal y gira a la derecha.
cloze: Go out of the ____ and turn right.
note: Use 'at the terminal' for airports in English, 'terminal' also means final.

definition: a small label with information, attached to something
example: You can put your name on a name tag.
exampleEs: Puedes poner tu nombre en una etiqueta.
cloze: You can put your name on a name ____.
note: A 'name tag' is a 'gafete' in Mexico; 'tag' is also a keyword label online.

definition: to make someone do something because it is necessary
example: We were obliged to give up our plan.
exampleEs: Fuimos obligados a abandonar nuestro plan.
cloze: We were ____ to give up our plan.
note: 'Obliged to' is formal; 'had to' is more common. 'Much obliged' is an old-fashioned thank you.

definition: a way of expressing your energy or feelings
example: Just because he's uncreative doesn't mean he doesn't need a creative outlet.
exampleEs: Solo porque no sea creativo no quiere decir que él no necesite un desahogo creativo.
cloze: Just because he's uncreative doesn't mean he doesn't need a creative ____.
note: Also means a store selling cheap brand-name goods or a power socket (US).

definition: to force someone to do something
example: The heavy rain compelled us to put off our departure.
exampleEs: La fuerte lluvia nos obligó a posponer nuestra salida.
cloze: The heavy rain ____ us to put off our departure.
note: Formal. 'Compelling' as an adjective means very convincing, not forced.

definition: the place where a person or thing is going
example: We'll reach our destination by the time the sun sets.
exampleEs: Llegaremos a nuestro destino para cuando el sol se ponga.
cloze: We'll reach our ____ by the time the sun sets.
note: Spanish 'destino' also means fate; destination only means the place you are going to.

definition: the part of a car that sends power from the engine to the wheels
example: Can you drive a car with manual transmission?
exampleEs: ¿Sabes conducir un coche con transmisión manual?
cloze: Can you drive a car with manual ____?

definition: harmful or unfavorable
example: There's no way to alleviate the adverse effects of the medication.
exampleEs: No hay modo de paliar los efectos adversos del medicamento.
cloze: There's no way to alleviate the ____ effects of the medication.
note: Not 'averse' (reluctant). Stress is on the second syllable: ad-VERSE.

definition: a feeling that something is probably wrong or true, without proof
example: I had a suspicion that he would leave me.
exampleEs: Tenía la sospecha de que él me dejaría.
cloze: I had a ____ that he would leave me.
note: Spelling: -sp- in the middle, and the ending is -cion (not -ción).

definition: to run away from danger or a bad situation
example: When the man saw a policeman, he fled.
exampleEs: Cuando el hombre vio a un policía, huyó.
cloze: When the man saw a policeman, he ____.
note: Irregular: flee, fled, fled.

definition: the floor at the bottom of a doorway, or the point where something begins
example: The groom took the bride in his arms before crossing the threshold of the house.
exampleEs: El novio cogió en brazos a la novia antes de atravesar el umbral de la habitación.
cloze: The groom took the bride in his arms before crossing the ____ of the house.

definition: the right to keep your personal life and information to yourself
example: People usually become famous at the cost of their privacy.
exampleEs: La gente por lo general se vuelve famosa a costa de su privacidad.
cloze: People usually become famous at the cost of their ____.
note: Pronounced PRY-vuh-see in US English; spelling has -acy, not -ity.

definition: in a bad way or at a low level
example: There's a lot of work that's poorly paid or not paid at all.
exampleEs: Hay mucho trabajo mal remunerado o no remunerado en absoluto.
cloze: There's a lot of work that's ____ paid or not paid at all.
note: 'Poorly' as an adverb means badly; do not confuse it with 'poor' (adjective, not rich).

definition: without a job but looking for work
example: Since I'm unemployed, I can't save up anything.
exampleEs: Como estoy desempleado no puedo ahorrar.
cloze: Since I'm ____, I can't save up anything.
note: Related noun is 'unemployment'. In English 'unemployed' is not used for a stopped machine.

definition: a sudden loss of mental or emotional health from stress
example: She is on the verge of a nervous breakdown.
exampleEs: Ella está al borde de una crisis nerviosa.
cloze: She is on the verge of a nervous ____.
note: Another common sense is a machine failure or a list of costs: 'cost breakdown'.

definition: a person chosen to speak officially for a group
example: Do you want to be the spokesman of our group?
exampleEs: ¿Desea ser el portavoz de nuestro grupo?
cloze: Do you want to be the ____ of our group?
note: Gender-neutral form is 'spokesperson'; 'speaker' is not the same thing.

definition: to stop fighting and accept that you have lost
example: The pirates had no choice but to surrender.
exampleEs: Los piratas no tuvieron más opción que rendirse.
cloze: The pirates had no choice but to ____.

definition: to build again something that was damaged or destroyed
example: The theater in my neighborhood is being rebuilt.
exampleEs: El teatro en mi barrio está siendo reconstruido.
cloze: The theater in my neighborhood is being ____.
note: Irregular: rebuild, rebuilt, rebuilt.

definition: a set of written questions used to collect information
example: It would only take a few minutes for you to fill out this questionnaire.
exampleEs: Te llevaría solo unos pocos minutos rellenar este cuestionario.
cloze: It would only take a few minutes for you to fill out this ____.
note: Spelling: double n and -aire ending. Not the same as 'quiz'.

definition: a line of people waiting for something
example: The queue for buying tickets was unbelievably long.
exampleEs: La cola para comprar los billetes era increíblemente larga.
cloze: The ____ for buying tickets was unbelievably long.
note: US English usually says 'line'; 'queue' is common in British English and in IT (message queue). Pronounced 'kyoo'.

definition: the whole period of a person's life
example: If that woman will love me for who I am for a lifetime, I would marry her.
exampleEs: Si esa mujer me amara por quién soy durante toda la vida, me casaría con ella.
cloze: If that woman will love me for who I am for a ____, I would marry her.

definition: a claim that someone did something wrong, made without proof
example: I hope you've got some proof to back up your allegations.
exampleEs: Espero que tengas alguna prueba que corrobore tus alegaciones.
cloze: I hope you've got some proof to back up your ____.
note: Spanish 'alegación' is a more neutral legal argument; 'allegation' implies an unproven accusation.

definition: the way a person uses and sees a program or device
example: The user interface of all apps should be black by default.
exampleEs: La interfaz de todas las aplicaciones deben ser negras por defecto.
cloze: The user ____ of all apps should be black by default.

definition: to cause a reaction or feeling, usually a strong one
example: His long absences were starting to provoke suspicion.
exampleEs: Sus prolongadas ausencias comenzaban a suscitar sospecha.
cloze: His long absences were starting to ____ suspicion.
note: Not the same as Spanish 'provocar' = 'to tempt' in some regions; here it means to cause.

definition: to provide with the tools or parts needed for a purpose
example: All the police cars were equipped with bulletproof glass.
exampleEs: Todos los vehículos policiales fueron equipados con vidrios blindados.
cloze: All the police cars were ____ with bulletproof glass.
note: Double p in the past form: equipped.

definition: the most basic and important quality of something
example: Freedom is the very essence of our democracy.
exampleEs: La libertad es la esencia misma de nuestra democracia.
cloze: Freedom is the very ____ of our democracy.

definition: a doctor's written order for medicine
example: Go to the doctor to get your prescription!
exampleEs: ¡Ve al médico a que te dé la receta!
cloze: Go to the doctor to get your ____!
note: Not 'receta' for cooking; that is 'recipe'.

definition: a text or speech changed from one language to another
example: We are collecting sentences and their translations into other languages.
exampleEs: Estamos reuniendo frases y sus traducciones en otras lenguas.
cloze: We are collecting sentences and their ____ into other languages.
note: Spelling: -tion (not -ción).

definition: one of the foods or items used to make something
example: The ingredients needed for this recipe are a bit expensive.
exampleEs: Los ingredientes necesarios para esta receta son un poco caros.
cloze: The ____ needed for this recipe are a bit expensive.
note: Pronounced in-GREE-dee-unt; stress on the second syllable.

definition: a unit of weight, about 907 kg (US) or 1,016 kg (UK)
example: Many tons of waste go into the landfill each month.
exampleEs: Muchas toneladas de basura van a los rellenos sanitarios mensualmente.
cloze: Many ____ of waste go into the landfill each month.
note: US ton = 2,000 lb; metric 'tonne' = 1,000 kg. Informal 'tons of' means a lot.

definition: the reason why a person does something
example: I will never be capable of understanding her motives.
exampleEs: Jamás seré capaz de entender sus motivos.
cloze: I will never be capable of understanding her ____.
note: Pronounced MOH-tiv, not 'mo-TEEV'.

definition: the process of putting software or equipment in place
example: Your computer will restart several times during installation.
exampleEs: Su computador se reiniciará varias veces durante la instalación.
cloze: Your computer will restart several times during ____.
note: Spelling: install has double l, and installation keeps it.

definition: to make someone suffer because they did something wrong
example: What's the best way to punish a dog?
exampleEs: ¿Cuál es la mejor forma de castigar a un perro?
cloze: What's the best way to ____ a dog?
note: Spelling: -ish, pronounced PUN-ish.

definition: to gather a crop when it is ready
example: Thanks to the nice weather, we were able to harvest all of the crops in a day.
exampleEs: Gracias al buen clima, nosotros pudimos realizar toda la cosecha en un día.
cloze: Thanks to the nice weather, we were able to ____ all of the crops in a day.

definition: a reason you give for disagreeing with something
example: Do you have any objection to this plan?
exampleEs: ¿Tienes alguna objeción a este plan?
cloze: Do you have any ____ to this plan?
note: Preposition: objection TO something.

definition: to face a difficult problem and deal with it directly
example: I think it's time for me to confront that problem.
exampleEs: Creo que ya es hora de que afronte ese problema.
cloze: I think it's time for me to ____ that problem.
note: Takes a direct object: confront a problem (not 'confront with').

definition: a penalty given to someone who did something wrong
example: We won't be able to escape punishment this time.
exampleEs: Esta vez no podremos escapar del castigo.
cloze: We won't be able to escape ____ this time.

definition: something valuable you give up to get something more important
example: They made many sacrifices to get their own house.
exampleEs: Ellos hicieron muchos sacrificios para adquirir su propia casa.
cloze: They made many ____ to get their own house.
note: Verb form: make sacrifices (not 'do sacrifices').

definition: a small hole where liquid or gas escapes
example: The rain was dripping through a leak in the roof.
exampleEs: La lluvia estaba goteando a través de una gotera en el techo.
cloze: The rain was dripping through a ____ in the roof.

definition: not good enough or not enough for a purpose
example: What percentage of illnesses are associated with inadequate diets?
exampleEs: ¿Qué porcentaje de las enfermedades está asociado a dietas inadecuadas?
cloze: What percentage of illnesses are associated with ____ diets?
note: Spelled with 'e' after the d: in-AD-e-quate; do not write 'inadecuate'.

definition: a unit for measuring land area
example: Each year, twenty-seven million acres of the tropical rainforests are destroyed.
exampleEs: Cada año, veintisiete millones de acres de los bosques tropicales son destruidos.
cloze: Each year, twenty-seven million ____ of the tropical rainforests are destroyed.
note: One acre is about 0.4 hectares; do not equate acres with hectares.

definition: very unpleasant or harmful
example: Acne coupled with eczema is a nasty combination.
exampleEs: El acné acompañado de eccema es una fea combinación.
cloze: Acne coupled with eczema is a ____ combination.

definition: to say publicly that something or someone is very bad
example: They condemned him for his cruelty to animals.
exampleEs: Lo reprobaron por su crueldad a los animales.
cloze: They ____ him for his cruelty to animals.
note: Pattern: condemn someone FOR something.

definition: to control someone or something in a clever, unfair way
example: Television is boring and disgusting, and it manipulates you.
exampleEs: La televisión es aburrida, repugnante y te manipula.
cloze: Television is boring and disgusting, and it ____ you.
note: Often negative, unlike the neutral sense of 'handle'.

definition: the state of being successful and having plenty of money
example: You must realize that prosperity does not last forever.
exampleEs: Debes darte cuenta de que la prosperidad no dura para siempre.
cloze: You must realize that ____ does not last forever.

definition: to make a hole in something with a tool
example: Miners occasionally find enormous caves when they drill through a stone wall.
exampleEs: Los mineros encuentran en ocasiones espeluncas enormes al horadar una pared de piedra.
cloze: Miners occasionally find enormous caves when they ____ through a stone wall.

definition: a game or problem that you solve by fitting pieces or thinking
example: How many times have you done this puzzle already?
exampleEs: ¿Cuántas veces ya armaste este rompecabezas?
cloze: How many times have you done this ____ already?

definition: to a greater degree than is normal
example: With her unusually lively gestures, she pulled our attention to her.
exampleEs: Con sus gestos extraordinariamente animosos, ella atrajo nuestra atención a ella.
cloze: With her ____ lively gestures, she pulled our attention to her.

definition: very strong, aggressive or intense
example: You're going to come up against fierce competition.
exampleEs: Va usted a tener una competencia feroz.
cloze: You're going to come up against ____ competition.

definition: the smallest unit of a substance, made of atoms
example: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
exampleEs: Una molécula de agua tiene dos átomos de hidrógeno y un átomo de oxígeno.
cloze: A water ____ has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

definition: a treatment that makes an illness go away completely
example: There is no cure for the common cold.
exampleEs: No hay cura para el resfrío común.
cloze: There is no ____ for the common cold.

definition: to make someone healthy again after an illness
example: Good food and good sleep will cure you of your cold.
exampleEs: Buena comida y buen sueño te curarán de tu resfriado.
cloze: Good food and good sleep will ____ you of your cold.
note: Pattern: cure someone OF an illness.

definition: money given to someone to make them act dishonestly
example: He is the last man to take a bribe.
exampleEs: Es el último hombre que acepta un soborno.
cloze: He is the last man to take a ____.
note: Use the article: 'a bribe'; the person gives it, the other one takes it.

definition: clear and easy for everyone to see
example: It's evident to everybody that he's in love.
exampleEs: Para todos es obvio que él está enamorado.
cloze: It's ____ to everybody that he's in love.

definition: an arrangement to keep a table, room or seat for you
example: How early do I have to make a reservation to qualify for the discount?
exampleEs: ¿Con cuanta antelación tengo que reservar para obtener el descuento?
cloze: How early do I have to make a ____ to qualify for the discount?
note: Say 'make a reservation', not 'do'. For a table or room, not a verb here.

definition: only and completely, with nothing else involved
example: The first point that requires clarification is that the design was purely experimental.
exampleEs: El primer punto que requiere aclaración es que el diseño fue puramente experimental.
cloze: The first point that requires clarification is that the design was ____ experimental.

definition: very keen and excited to do something
example: I would hope that my teachers were eager to work.
exampleEs: Me haría ilusión que mis profesores tuvieran ganas de trabajar.
cloze: I would hope that my teachers were ____ to work.
note: False friend: 'eager' means keen and positive, not 'ansioso' as in anxious.

definition: available or happening only at a certain time of year
example: What are the advantages of eating seasonal fruit?
exampleEs: ¿Cuáles son las ventajas de comer fruta de temporada?
cloze: What are the advantages of eating ____ fruit?

definition: an organization for research, education or professional work
example: He bestowed a large amount of money on the institute.
exampleEs: Él donó una gran suma de dinero para el instituto.
cloze: He bestowed a large amount of money on the ____.
note: Spelling: institute (not 'instituto').

definition: a residential area on the edge of a city
example: I think it's time for me to move to the suburbs.
exampleEs: Creo que es hora de que me mude a los suburbios.
cloze: I think it's time for me to move to the ____.
note: In US English suburbs are often middle-class residential areas, not poor ones like 'suburbios' sometimes implies.

definition: a physical or mental condition that limits what a person can do
example: Have you ever been diagnosed with a learning disability?
exampleEs: ¿Te han diagnosticado alguna vez de una discapacidad del aprendizaje?
cloze: Have you ever been diagnosed with a learning ____?

definition: not completely, only in part
example: Various cupolas of the cathedral partially collapsed due to the earthquake.
exampleEs: Varias cúpulas de la catedral se desmoronaron parcialmente por el terremoto.
cloze: Various cupolas of the cathedral ____ collapsed due to the earthquake.

definition: a person who comes after or supports someone or something
example: Innovation is the difference between a pathfinder and a path follower.
exampleEs: La innovación es la diferencia entre el que muestra el camino y el que lo sigue.
cloze: Innovation is the difference between a pathfinder and a path ____.

definition: a book or website with facts about many subjects
example: My father had an antique encyclopedia that we still keep.
exampleEs: Mi padre tenía una enciclopedia antigua que todavía conservamos.
cloze: My father had an antique ____ that we still keep.
note: Pronounced en-SY-kluh-PEE-dee-uh, with stress on PEE.

definition: a small solid piece of something with no particular shape
example: Please put a lump of sugar in my coffee.
exampleEs: Por favor, ponga un terrón de azúcar en mi café.
cloze: Please put a ____ of sugar in my coffee.

definition: an official, detailed investigation into something
example: Investigators are running a probe into what caused the crash.
exampleEs: Los científicos están realizando una investigación para saber lo que causó el accidente.
cloze: Investigators are running a ____ into what caused the crash.

definition: in a way that is not direct or obvious
example: It's clear that his comments were intended to offend me indirectly.
exampleEs: Está claro que sus comentarios pretendían ofenderme indirectamente.
cloze: It's clear that his comments were intended to offend me ____.

definition: for a short time only, not permanently
example: The library is temporarily closed to the public.
exampleEs: La biblioteca está temporalmente cerrada al público.
cloze: The library is ____ closed to the public.

definition: of good enough quality or standard
example: I think it's time for me to buy a decent camera.
exampleEs: Creo que es hora de que me compre una cámara decente.
cloze: I think it's time for me to buy a ____ camera.
note: False friend: here 'decent' means good enough in quality, not morally 'decente'.

definition: the feeling that you want to eat
example: A short stroll along the beach gave me a good appetite for breakfast.
exampleEs: Un pequeño paseo por la playa me causó un gran apetito para desayunar.
cloze: A short stroll along the beach gave me a good ____ for breakfast.
note: Stress on the first syllable: AP-i-tite.

definition: to keep a person or thing in a limited space or place
example: He's been confined to bed for the past three months.
exampleEs: Está enfermo en cama desde hace tres meses.
cloze: He's been ____ to bed for the past three months.
note: Pattern: confined TO a place.

definition: a meeting to get advice from an expert
example: I'd like to have a consultation about getting braces.
exampleEs: Quisiera hacer una consulta para usar frenillos.
cloze: I'd like to have a ____ about getting braces.

definition: the flat surface at the top of a room
example: He gazed at the ceiling for a long time.
exampleEs: Estuvo mirando el cielo raso durante un largo rato.
cloze: He gazed at the ____ for a long time.
note: 'Techo' of a house is 'roof'; inside a room it is 'ceiling'.

definition: to keep doing something even when it is difficult or pointless
example: Why persist in writing essays if one has not even mastered the art of writing succinct sentences?
exampleEs: ¿Para qué se empeña en escribir ensayos si ni siquiera ha dominado el arte de escribir oraciones sucintas?
cloze: Why ____ in writing essays if one has not even mastered the art of writing succinct sentences?
note: Pattern: persist IN doing something.

definition: doubtful and not easily convinced
example: People are often quite skeptical about things unless given believable proof.
exampleEs: La gente es a menudo bastante escéptica con las cosas, a menos que les den pruebas creíbles.
cloze: People are often quite ____ about things unless given believable proof.
note: Spelling: US 'skeptical', UK 'sceptical'; pronounced with /sk/.

definition: a large, thick piece of something
example: George tried to enjoy the steak, but a chunk of gristle ruined the last bite.
exampleEs: George intentó disfrutar del filete pero un trozo de cartílago le estropeó el último bocado.
cloze: George tried to enjoy the steak, but a ____ of gristle ruined the last bite.

definition: a small picture on a screen that you click
example: To edit a sentence, click on the pencil icon.
exampleEs: Para editar una frase, haga clic en el icono de lápiz.
cloze: To edit a sentence, click on the pencil ____.
note: Pronounced EYE-kon.

definition: rising or falling at a sharp angle
example: From this point the climb suddenly became steep.
exampleEs: Desde este punto la subida empezó de repente a ser empinada.
cloze: From this point the climb suddenly became ____.

definition: a chemical that can burn or dissolve things
example: I read an article about acid rain yesterday.
exampleEs: Ayer leí un artículo sobre la lluvia ácida.
cloze: I read an article about ____ rain yesterday.

definition: a hopeful feeling that things will go well
example: There is considerable optimism that the economy will improve.
exampleEs: Hay un considerable optimismo de que la economía mejorará.
cloze: There is considerable ____ that the economy will improve.

definition: causing emotional or physical hurt
example: I know this has been a painful experience.
exampleEs: Sé que esta ha sido una experiencia dolorosa.
cloze: I know this has been a ____ experience.

definition: to officially end a law or rule
example: The regulation was abolished, but then it was reenacted.
exampleEs: La reglamentación fue abolida, pero después fue promulgada de nuevo.
cloze: The regulation was ____, but then it was reenacted.
note: Pronounced uh-BOL-ish, not like Spanish abolir.

definition: to receive something from a parent or earlier generation
example: We have inherited the gift of music from animals such as insects and birds.
exampleEs: Hemos heredado el don de la música de animales como los insectos y los pájaros.
cloze: We have ____ the gift of music from animals such as insects and birds.

definition: an online place where people post and discuss topics
example: I contribute to this forum almost every day.
exampleEs: Contribuyo a este foro casi todos los días.
cloze: I contribute to this ____ almost every day.
note: Plural is 'forums' (or formal 'fora'), not 'forumes'.

definition: a careful change made to improve a text or plan
example: I quickly realized that my text needed an exhaustive revision.
exampleEs: Pronto me dio la impresión de que mi texto necesitaba una revisión exhaustiva.
cloze: I quickly realized that my text needed an exhaustive ____.
note: Means changing a text to improve it, not only checking it.

definition: the state of being needed
example: There is no necessity for you to do that.
exampleEs: No hace falta que hagas eso.
cloze: There is no ____ for you to do that.
note: Stress: ne-CESS-i-ty.

definition: a thin thread of material in a body or fabric
example: Muscles are made of hundreds of thin fibers.
exampleEs: Los músculos están conformados por cientos de delgadas fibras.
cloze: Muscles are made of hundreds of thin ____.
note: US spelling 'fiber'; UK 'fibre'.

definition: a small enclosed space for one animal in a barn
example: The horse never refuses to gallop to its stall.
exampleEs: El caballo nunca se niega a galopar a su caseta.
cloze: The horse never refuses to gallop to its ____.
note: Also means a market booth; in a barn it means an animal's compartment.

definition: permission to enter or join a place or group
example: He applied for admission to the riding club.
exampleEs: Solicitó la admisión en el club de equitación.
cloze: He applied for ____ to the riding club.
note: Also means 'confession'; here it means entry.

definition: the part of a shirt that goes around the neck
example: I need a shirt with a stiff collar.
exampleEs: Necesito una camisa de cuello duro.
cloze: I need a shirt with a stiff ____.

es: banda ancha, internet de banda ancha
definition: fast internet connection that carries a lot of data
example: There are big differences in broadband speed and quality from country to country.
exampleEs: Hay grandes diferencias en la velocidad y calidad de ancho de banda entre país y país.
cloze: There are big differences in ____ speed and quality from country to country.
note: Say 'broadband' (one word), not 'ancho de banda' literally.

definition: the movement of blood around the body
example: Is it true that ginger increases circulation and improves your metabolism?
exampleEs: ¿Es cierto que el jengibre facilita la circulación y mejora el metabolismo?
cloze: Is it true that ginger increases ____ and improves your metabolism?
note: Also means copies of a newspaper sold.

definition: a set of clothes worn together
example: She needs to change her outfit before the party this evening.
exampleEs: Ella necesita cambiar su traje antes de la fiesta esta noche.
cloze: She needs to change her ____ before the party this evening.
note: Spanish 'traje' is a suit; 'outfit' is any clothes combination.

definition: based on guesses rather than facts
example: Take care and try not to speak on speculative things.
exampleEs: Ándate con cuidado y trata de no hablar de cuestiones especulativas.
cloze: Take care and try not to speak on ____ things.
note: Stress: SPEC-yuh-luh-tiv.

definition: to look like or be similar to
example: There's a theory that dog owners often resemble their dogs.
exampleEs: Hay una teoría que dice que los dueños usualmente se parecen a sus perros.
cloze: There's a theory that dog owners often ____ their dogs.
note: No preposition: 'resemble someone', not 'resemble to'.

definition: the act of studying something in detail to learn more
example: Poetry is an exploration, a revelation, and an invitation for dialogue.
exampleEs: La poesía es una exploración, una revelación y una invitación al diálogo.
cloze: Poetry is an ____, a revelation, and an invitation for dialogue.

definition: in a way that is planned and done on purpose
example: The most perfidious way of harming a cause consists of defending it deliberately with faulty arguments.
exampleEs: La forma más pérfida de dañar una causa consiste en defenderla deliberadamente con argumentos falsos.
cloze: The most perfidious way of harming a cause consists of defending it ____ with faulty arguments.
note: Pronounced de-LIB-er-it-ly.

definition: a person whose job is making houses and other structures
example: The builder is installing tile on the wall.
exampleEs: El albañil está alicatando la pared.
cloze: The ____ is installing tile on the wall.
note: Spanish 'albañil' is often 'builder' or 'bricklayer'; builder is more general.

definition: to affect someone so strongly that they struggle to cope
example: He was overwhelmed with the heavy burden of his duties.
exampleEs: Él estaba abrumado con la pesada carga de sus deberes.
cloze: He was ____ with the heavy burden of his duties.
note: Use 'overwhelmed with/by', not 'overwhelmed of'.

definition: quickly and without delay
example: I was surprised at her inability to do things promptly.
exampleEs: Estaba sorprendido de su incapacidad para hacer las cosas rápidamente.
cloze: I was surprised at her inability to do things ____.

definition: noticing and aware of something
example: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
exampleEs: El guerrero es consciente tanto de su fortaleza, cuanto de su debilidad.
cloze: The warrior is ____ of both his strength and his weakness.
note: Use 'conscious of', not 'conscious about' for awareness.

definition: a machine that can do tasks automatically
example: A robot can do more work than a man can.
exampleEs: Un robot puede hacer más trabajo de lo que un humano puede.
cloze: A ____ can do more work than a man can.

definition: the main screen on a computer where files and icons are shown
example: I used a photo of my dog for my desktop wallpaper.
exampleEs: Usé una foto de mi perro como fondo de pantalla.
cloze: I used a photo of my dog for my ____ wallpaper.

definition: a program or machine that works with information
example: Should the word processor go wrong, we guarantee to replace it free of charge.
exampleEs: Si el procesador de palabras se estropeara, nosotros garantizamos reemplazarlo libre de cargos.
cloze: Should the word ____ go wrong, we guarantee to replace it free of charge.
note: 'Word processor' is a fixed phrase for writing software.

definition: to make something change direction
example: The flood diverted the course of the river.
exampleEs: La inundación desvió el curso del río.
cloze: The flood ____ the course of the river.
note: Pronounced di-VERT, stress on second syllable.

definition: a group of people sent to represent others
example: It was the first delegation that the new country had ever received.
exampleEs: Fue la primera delegación que el nuevo país hubiese recibido alguna vez.
cloze: It was the first ____ that the new country had ever received.
note: Also means giving tasks to others at work.

definition: the official decision made at the end of a trial
example: The jury has returned a verdict of guilty.
exampleEs: El jurado había dictado un veredicto de culpa.
cloze: The jury has returned a ____ of guilty.
note: Pronounced VER-dikt; 'jury' returns a verdict.

definition: a small round mark
example: The cats are curious about the red dot on the wall.
exampleEs: Los gatos están curiosos con el punto rojo en la pared.
cloze: The cats are curious about the red ____ on the wall.
note: In web addresses say 'dot', e.g. 'example dot com'.

definition: a natural substance found in the ground
example: The region is relatively rich in mineral resources.
exampleEs: La región es relativamente rica en recursos minerales.
cloze: The region is relatively rich in ____ resources.
note: Stress: MIN-er-al, three syllables.

definition: a sudden loud burst with great force
example: The whole sky lit up and there was an explosion.
exampleEs: El cielo entero se iluminó y hubo una explosión.
cloze: The whole sky lit up and there was an ____.
note: Stress: ex-PLO-sion; spelled with x, not s.

definition: money or goods given to help a cause
example: Thank you very much for your generous donation.
exampleEs: Gracias por su generosa donación.
cloze: Thank you very much for your generous ____.

definition: in or between different countries
example: Algeria isn't limited by who it can trade with internationally.
exampleEs: Argelia no está limitada por con quién puede comerciar internacionalmente.
cloze: Algeria isn't limited by who it can trade with ____.

definition: a tiny bright piece of fire
example: Watch out for the sparks that are flying out of the fireplace!
exampleEs: ¡Cuidado con las chispas que saltan de la chimenea!
cloze: Watch out for the ____ that are flying out of the fireplace!
note: Spark can also be a verb meaning 'to start'.

definition: to put something briefly into a liquid
example: She dipped her ankles in the hot water.
exampleEs: Ella sumergió sus tobillos en el agua caliente.
cloze: She ____ her ankles in the hot water.
note: Past tense doubles the p: dipped.

definition: a reddish metal used in wires and pipes
example: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
exampleEs: El latón es una aleación de cobre y zinc.
cloze: Brass is an alloy of ____ and zinc.

definition: having a strong sharp taste that is not sweet
example: The tea is really bitter and doesn't taste good.
exampleEs: El té sabe muy amargo y no está bueno.
cloze: The tea is really ____ and doesn't taste good.
note: Also means resentful: 'bitter about' a decision.

definition: a grain used to make flour and bread
example: Because of the poor harvest, wheat prices have gone up in the last six months.
exampleEs: Debido a la mala cosecha, el precio del trigo ha subido en los últimos seis meses.
cloze: Because of the poor harvest, ____ prices have gone up in the last six months.

definition: in a way related to money
example: My neighbors are financially stable, in other words, rich.
exampleEs: Mis vecinos son financieramente estables, es decir, ricos.
cloze: My neighbors are ____ stable, in other words, rich.
note: Spelling: financially has a double l.

definition: at a later time
example: Now I'm busy, but if you want, we can speak afterward.
exampleEs: Ahora estoy ocupado, pero si quieres podemos hablar después.
cloze: Now I'm busy, but if you want, we can speak ____.
note: US 'afterward'; UK often 'afterwards'.

definition: again and again over a long time
example: If the universe is full of stars, why doesn't their light continually light up the entire sky?
exampleEs: Si el universo está lleno de estrellas, ¿por qué la luz que proviene de todas ellas no hace que brille continuamente el cielo entero?
cloze: If the universe is full of stars, why doesn't their light ____ light up the entire sky?
note: 'Continually' means repeated; 'continuously' means without stopping.

definition: making people feel uncomfortable or embarrassed
example: There was an awkward silence when he appeared.
exampleEs: Hubo un silencio incómodo cuando él apareció.
cloze: There was an ____ silence when he appeared.
note: Often means uncomfortable situations, not only clumsy (torpe).

definition: a medicine given to protect against disease
example: The vaccine was tested on animals in a laboratory.
exampleEs: La vacuna se ha probado con animales en laboratorio.
cloze: The ____ was tested on animals in a laboratory.
note: Spelling: vaccine has a double c.

definition: the taste of food or drink
example: Do you think a little salt would improve the flavor?
exampleEs: ¿Crees que un poco de sal mejorará el sabor?
cloze: Do you think a little salt would improve the ____?
note: US spelling 'flavor'; UK 'flavour'.

definition: a lack of interest or care
example: These problems have arisen as a result of indifference.
exampleEs: Estos problemas han surgido como un resultado de la indiferencia.
cloze: These problems have arisen as a result of ____.
note: Use 'indifference to', not 'indifference of'.

definition: to find something that was hidden
example: I dare not probe too deeply, lest I uncover the awful truth!
exampleEs: ¡No me atrevo a investigar demasiado profundamente, para no descubrir la horrorosa verdad!
cloze: I dare not probe too deeply, lest I ____ the awful truth!
note: 'Descubrir' can be 'discover' or 'uncover'; uncover implies hidden.

definition: to mix so that parts cannot be seen separately
example: The sky seemed to blend with the sea.
exampleEs: El cielo parecía fundirse con el mar.
cloze: The sky seemed to ____ with the sea.
note: Say 'blend in' for fitting into a group.

definition: a person who entertains an audience
example: We gave the performer a round of applause.
exampleEs: Nosotros le dimos un aplauso al intérprete.
cloze: We gave the ____ a round of applause.
note: Also used at work: 'top performer' means a high-achieving employee.

definition: not moving or changing, often about an electric charge
example: The static electricity started to make our hair stand on end.
exampleEs: La electricidad estática comenzó a erizarnos el pelo.
cloze: The ____ electricity started to make our hair stand on end.

definition: very impressive and beautiful to look at
example: This eyeshadow looks spectacular on me, doesn't it?
exampleEs: Esta sombra de ojos me queda espectacular, ¿verdad?
cloze: This eyeshadow looks ____ on me, doesn't it?

definition: important or good enough to be noticed
example: Chemistry has made notable progress in recent years.
exampleEs: La química progresó notablemente los últimos años.
cloze: Chemistry has made ____ progress in recent years.

definition: parts of the body, like the heart, that do a special job
example: We dissected a frog to examine its internal organs.
exampleEs: Diseccionamos una rana para examinar sus órganos internos.
cloze: We dissected a frog to examine its internal ____.

definition: to break the rules in order to win or get an advantage
example: Was it you who squealed to the teacher that I cheated?
exampleEs: ¿Fuiste tú el que le sopló al maestro que le hice trampa?
cloze: Was it you who squealed to the teacher that I ____?
note: In Spanish you say 'hacer trampa'; in English use 'cheat' alone or 'cheat on a test'.

definition: to begin or start from a particular place or cause
example: We must find out where this fire originates.
exampleEs: Debemos descubrir dónde se origina este fuego.
cloze: We must find out where this fire ____.
note: Common prepositions: originate in (a place) and originate from or with (a source).

definition: the act of stopping something bad from happening
example: The prevention of forest fires is everyone's responsibility.
exampleEs: La prevención de los incendios forestales es responsabilidad de todos.
cloze: The ____ of forest fires is everyone's responsibility.

definition: a ruler who has complete power over a country
example: Spain was ruled by a dictator until the year nineteen seventy-five.
exampleEs: España fue dirigida por un dictador hasta el año mil novecientos setenta y cinco.
cloze: Spain was ruled by a ____ until the year nineteen seventy-five.
note: Stress is on the first syllable: DIK-tay-ter.

definition: clear enough that you can see through it
example: Glass is a transparent and easily breakable material.
exampleEs: El vidrio es un material transparente y fácil de romper.
cloze: Glass is a ____ and easily breakable material.
note: Also means open and honest in business: a transparent process.

definition: to affect something in a way that causes problems
example: Are you sure that these two medications don't interfere with each other?
exampleEs: ¿Estas seguro de que estos dos medicamentos no se antagonizan entre sí?
cloze: Are you sure that these two medications don't ____ with each other?
note: Use 'interfere WITH' something; 'interfere IN' means to get involved in other people's business.

definition: able to be replaced naturally, so it does not run out
example: There is a need to develop more renewable energy sources.
exampleEs: Falta desarrollar más las energías renovables.
cloze: There is a need to develop more ____ energy sources.

definition: an official stamp or paper that lets you enter a country
example: This virus travels without a passport or a visa.
exampleEs: Este virus viaja sin pasaporte ni visado.
cloze: This virus travels without a passport or a ____.
note: In English, 'visa' is the travel permit; the Spanish 'visa' can also mean the card brand.

definition: a soft plant fiber used to make cloth and clothes
example: Among the products of this region, cotton predominates.
exampleEs: Entre los productos de esta región domina el algodón.
cloze: Among the products of this region, ____ predominates.

definition: good enough to meet what is needed or expected
example: No matter who you ask, you won't be able to get a satisfactory answer.
exampleEs: Sin importar a quién le preguntes, no vas a poder obtener una respuesta satisfactoria.
cloze: No matter who you ask, you won't be able to get a ____ answer.
note: Satisfactory means good enough, not excellent.

definition: needing to be dealt with right away
example: There is an urgent need for them to update their system.
exampleEs: Se requiere urgentemente que ellos actualicen sus sistemas.
