cloze: There is an ____ need for them to update their system.
note: Pronounce the first syllable like 'her': UR-jent. Use 'an' before it.

definition: not too expensive for most people to pay
example: Solar energy is abundant, clean, affordable and renewable.
exampleEs: La energía solar es abundante, limpia, asequible y renovable.
cloze: Solar energy is abundant, clean, ____ and renewable.
note: 'Affordable' means a fair price; it is not 'afortunado' or 'comfortable'.

definition: extra material or support added to make something stronger
example: The steel columns tend to be covered by concrete for reinforcement.
exampleEs: Las columnas de acero suelen ser recubiertas por hormigón para reforzarlas.
cloze: The steel columns tend to be covered by concrete for ____.

definition: to think that something is smaller or less important than it is
example: People have a tendency to underestimate their future needs.
exampleEs: Las personas tienden a subestimar sus necesidades futuras.
cloze: People have a tendency to ____ their future needs.
note: Spelling trap: it is 'underestimate', not 'subestimate'.

definition: to accept something unpleasant without complaining or stopping it
example: I don't tolerate anyone shouting at me, because I consider it a lack of respect.
exampleEs: No tolero que nadie me grite, porque lo considero una falta de respeto.
cloze: I don't ____ anyone shouting at me, because I consider it a lack of respect.
note: Tolerate takes a direct object: 'tolerate delays', not 'tolerate to delays'.

definition: the science of matter, energy, force and motion
example: He decided to specialize in physics at college.
exampleEs: Él decidió especializarse en física en la universidad.
cloze: He decided to specialize in ____ at college.
note: Singular despite the final -s: 'Physics is hard'. Stress the second syllable: PHYS-iks.

definition: small and not easy to notice
example: There is a subtle difference between the two words.
exampleEs: Hay una sutil diferencia entre las dos palabras.
cloze: There is a ____ difference between the two words.
note: The 'b' is silent: /ˈsʌtl/.

definition: a strong, short feeling of love for someone
example: Do you have a crush on my brother?
exampleEs: ¿Estás enamorada de mi hermano?
cloze: Do you have a ____ on my brother?
note: Use the preposition ON: 'have a crush on someone'.

definition: a machine used in the home, such as a fridge or oven
example: The accident was caused by a fault in the refrigeration system of the appliance.
exampleEs: El accidente fue causado por una falla en el sistema de refrigeración del aparato.
cloze: The accident was caused by a fault in the refrigeration system of the ____.
note: Stress the second syllable: ap-PLY-ance.

definition: not often; almost never
example: I live near her house, but I seldom see her.
exampleEs: Vivo cerca de su casa, pero raramente la veo.
cloze: I live near her house, but I ____ see her.
note: It already has a negative meaning, so don't add 'not': 'I seldom go', not 'I don't seldom go'.

definition: not certain; probably not going to happen
example: It is doubtful if we can get the engine working.
exampleEs: No está claro que podamos hacer funcionar el motor.
cloze: It is ____ if we can get the engine working.
note: After 'doubtful' use 'if', 'whether' or 'that'.

definition: a medicine put into the body with a needle
example: The nurse gave an injection to the patient.
exampleEs: La enfermera le aplicó una inyección al paciente.
cloze: The nurse gave an ____ to the patient.
note: Spelling: -tion ending (injection), pronounced /ɪnˈdʒekʃən/.

definition: an aircraft with large spinning blades on top that can fly straight up
example: A helicopter is able to take off and land straight up and down.
exampleEs: Un helicóptero es capaz de despegar y aterrizar verticalmente.
cloze: A ____ is able to take off and land straight up and down.
note: Pronounce it HEL-i-cop-ter, with stress on the first syllable.

definition: not too hot or cold, and not extreme
example: The climate here is very mild, so it seldom snows here even in the winter.
exampleEs: El clima aquí es muy suave, así que rara vez nieva aquí incluso cuando es invierno.
cloze: The climate here is very ____, so it seldom snows here even in the winter.
note: 'Mild' is not always 'suave': for weather think 'templado'.

definition: the state of not being able to do something
example: I am impatient with his inability to make decisions.
exampleEs: Su incapacidad para tomar decisiones me impacienta.
cloze: I am impatient with his ____ to make decisions.
note: Followed by 'to + verb': 'inability to decide', not 'inability of deciding'.

definition: a glass building where plants are grown
example: He keeps his gardening supplies in the greenhouse.
exampleEs: Él guarda sus utensilios de jardinería en el invernadero.
cloze: He keeps his gardening supplies in the ____.

definition: to ask for something in a very emotional or urgent way
example: She pleaded with him to stay a little bit longer.
exampleEs: Ella le rogó que se quedase un poquito más.
cloze: She ____ with him to stay a little bit longer.
note: Use 'plead WITH someone to do' something; 'plead for' is for what you ask.

definition: used in the phrase 'in ... of' to mean even though
example: In spite of the hurricane, the ship reached port.
exampleEs: A pesar del huracán la nave llegó al puerto.
cloze: In ____ of the hurricane, the ship reached port.
note: Say 'in spite of' (with 'of'); 'despite' has no 'of'.

definition: complete and careful, with nothing missing
example: The verifications of the process have to be extremely thorough.
exampleEs: Las comprobaciones del proceso han de ser extremadamente minuciosas.
cloze: The verifications of the process have to be extremely ____.
note: Pronounced /ˈθʌrə/ (like 'thurra'), not like 'through' or 'though'.

definition: cows and bulls kept on a farm
example: When we lived in the village, we kept cattle.
exampleEs: Cuando vivíamos en el pueblo, criábamos ganado.
cloze: When we lived in the village, we kept ____.
note: 'Cattle' is always plural with no -s: 'The cattle are in the field'.

definition: people who have just arrived in a place or group
example: The newcomers were quickly absorbed into the community.
exampleEs: Los recién llegados fueron rápidamente absorbidos a la comunidad.
cloze: The ____ were quickly absorbed into the community.

definition: very valuable and important, so not to be wasted
example: My father used to say that time is precious.
exampleEs: Mi padre solía decir que el tiempo es oro.
cloze: My father used to say that time is ____.
note: 'Precioso' in Spanish often means beautiful; 'precious' means valuable.

definition: to get something back after losing it
example: He regained consciousness and was able to talk.
exampleEs: Él recuperó la conciencia y fue capaz de hablar.
cloze: He ____ consciousness and was able to talk.

definition: something a person does, especially something good or bad
example: I always feel good after I do my good deed for the day.
exampleEs: Siempre me siento bien después de hacer mi buena acción del día.
cloze: I always feel good after I do my good ____ for the day.
note: Pronounced /diːd/, like 'dead' but with a long 'ee' sound.

definition: having the skill and knowledge to do a job well
example: He had two or three rather competent assistants.
exampleEs: Él tuvo dos o tres asistentes bastante competentes.
cloze: He had two or three rather ____ assistants.

definition: worked by a machine or by moving parts
example: One of the benefits of using mechanical pencils is that you don't need to use a pencil sharpener.
exampleEs: Uno de los beneficios de usar portaminas es que no necesitas utilizar sacapuntas.
cloze: One of the benefits of using ____ pencils is that you don't need to use a pencil sharpener.
note: Stress the second syllable: me-CHAN-i-cal.

definition: to take something important away from someone
example: The new law has deprived the citizens of their liberty.
exampleEs: La nueva ley ha despojado a los ciudadanos de su libertad.
cloze: The new law has ____ the citizens of their liberty.
note: Pattern: deprive SOMEONE OF something.

definition: made to be thrown away after one use
example: I think that people should stop using disposable shopping bags.
exampleEs: Creo que la gente debería dejar de utilizar las bolsas de compra desechables.
cloze: I think that people should stop using ____ shopping bags.
note: 'Disposable' is not 'disponible' (available).

definition: to put furniture in a room or building
example: The couple spent a lot of money on furnishing their house.
exampleEs: La pareja gastó mucho dinero en amueblar su casa.
cloze: The couple spent a lot of money on ____ their house.
note: 'Furnish' is not 'furnir'; to supply information use 'provide'.

definition: impossible to know or guess before it happens
example: I can't stop thinking about the unpredictable consequences this will bring.
exampleEs: No puedo dejar de pensar en las consecuencias impredecibles que esto acarreará.
cloze: I can't stop thinking about the ____ consequences this will bring.

definition: a large amount of something that has gathered slowly over time
example: A cloud is an accumulation of water vapour in the sky.
exampleEs: Una nube es una acumulación de vapor de agua en el cielo.
cloze: A cloud is an ____ of water vapour in the sky.

definition: to remove water or liquid from something
example: The plumber pumped out the water in order to drain the pipe.
exampleEs: El plomero sacó el agua con una bomba para drenar la tubería.
cloze: The plumber pumped out the water in order to ____ the pipe.

definition: to leave a place, especially to start a journey
example: A stranger you arrive, a friend you depart.
exampleEs: Llegas como extraño y te vas como amigo.
cloze: A stranger you arrive, a friend you ____.
note: Use 'depart from' a place; it is more formal than 'leave'.

definition: making you feel that something is wrong or dishonest
example: The way she spoke to us was suspicious.
exampleEs: La manera en que ella nos habló fue sospechosa.
cloze: The way she spoke to us was ____.
note: Spanish 'sospechoso' is similar, but 'suspicious of someone' means you distrust them.

definition: without any doubt; certainly
example: Metal cases are undoubtedly tougher, but much more expensive.
exampleEs: Las cajas de metal son sin lugar a dudas más resistentes, pero mucho más caras.
cloze: Metal cases are ____ tougher, but much more expensive.

definition: the movement of people or goods from one place to another
example: I listen to the radio while in transit.
exampleEs: Escucho la radio en el trayecto.
cloze: I listen to the radio while in ____.
note: 'In transit' is common for shipments and travellers; it does not mean 'transit' as a visa.

definition: not clear or not detailed
example: I have a very vague idea of what you are talking about.
exampleEs: Tengo una idea muy vaga de lo que estás hablando.
cloze: I have a very ____ idea of what you are talking about.

definition: a style or trend that is very popular for a short time
example: Jeans are all the rage with the ladies nowadays.
exampleEs: Los jeans están de moda entre las chicas estos días.
cloze: Jeans are all the ____ with the ladies nowadays.
note: 'All the rage' is a fixed idiom meaning very fashionable; 'rage' alone usually means strong anger.

definition: a very old story about gods or heroes from a culture
example: The mountain is famous in myth and legend.
exampleEs: La montaña es famosa en mitos y leyendas.
cloze: The mountain is famous in ____ and legend.

definition: to remove something that was written, saved or posted
example: I can't figure out how to delete what I just posted.
exampleEs: No puedo averiguar cómo eliminar lo que acabo de postear.
cloze: I can't figure out how to ____ what I just posted.

definition: not made correctly and so not working properly
example: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.
exampleEs: Algunas enfermedades son provocadas por un gen defectuoso.
cloze: Some diseases are caused by a ____ gene.

definition: not ready or not wanting to do something
example: It's difficult to teach people what they're unwilling to learn.
exampleEs: Es difícil enseñar a la gente lo que no están dispuestos a aprender.
cloze: It's difficult to teach people what they're ____ to learn.
note: Use 'unwilling to' + verb: 'unwilling to learn', not 'unwilling of'.

definition: for a low price
example: I found out where to buy fruit cheaply.
exampleEs: Encontré dónde comprar fruta barata.
cloze: I found out where to buy fruit ____.
note: The adverb is 'cheaply', not 'cheap' (except in 'buy it cheap', which is informal).

definition: a chemical compound with two oxygen atoms
example: The two main forms in which carbon appears on the earth are carbon dioxide and methane.
exampleEs: Las dos formas principales en que el carbono aparece en la tierra son el dióxido de carbono y el metano.
cloze: The two main forms in which carbon appears on the earth are carbon ____ and methane.
note: Spelling: 'dioxide' ends in -ide, not -ite; stress is on the second syllable.

definition: to burst suddenly and violently with a loud noise
example: The car exploded a few moments after the collision.
exampleEs: El auto explotó pocos instantes después del impacto.
cloze: The car ____ a few moments after the collision.

definition: a light silver-colored metal used for cans and cases
example: There was a time when aluminum was more expensive than gold.
exampleEs: Hubo una época en la que el aluminio fue más caro que el oro.
cloze: There was a time when ____ was more expensive than gold.
note: US spelling is 'aluminum'; British English writes 'aluminium'.

definition: not producing the result you wanted
example: Without the participation of the youth, democracy is ineffective.
exampleEs: Sin la participación de los jóvenes, la democracia no tiene eficacia.
cloze: Without the participation of the youth, democracy is ____.
note: Spanish 'ineficaz' matches 'ineffective'; 'inefficient' means wasteful of time or resources.

definition: a formal statement given in court about what you know
example: The witnesses were able to refute the false testimony of the suspect.
exampleEs: Los testigos pudieron refutar el falso testimonio del sospechoso.
cloze: The witnesses were able to refute the false ____ of the suspect.

definition: small printed booklets with information about a product or place
example: Would you give me some travel brochures from your country?
exampleEs: ¿Podrías darme algunos folletos de viaje de tu país?
cloze: Would you give me some travel ____ from your country?
note: Pronounced 'bro-SHOOR'; it is not 'brochura' and not the Spanish 'brocha'.

definition: the very beginning, before anything has been done
example: Perform an experiment in creating a country from scratch.
exampleEs: Realice un ensayo sobre cómo crear un país desde cero.
cloze: Perform an experiment in creating a country from ____.
note: The idiom 'from scratch' means starting with nothing; it is not about scratching a surface.

definition: the hard seed in the middle of some fruits
example: It's the first time I've swallowed a peach pit!
exampleEs: ¡Es la primera vez que me trago el cuesco de un durazno!
cloze: It's the first time I've swallowed a peach ____!
note: This is US usage; British English says 'stone'.

definition: to write something again to improve it
example: The teacher told him to rewrite the essay.
exampleEs: El profesor le dijo que reescribiera el ensayo.
cloze: The teacher told him to ____ the essay.

definition: rude or insulting, and likely to upset people
example: I find just the memory of his overly polite patronizing manner really offensive.
exampleEs: Encuentro realmente ofensivo incluso el recuerdo de su forma demasiado cortés de condescender.
cloze: I find just the memory of his overly polite patronizing manner really ____.
note: 'Offensive' is also a sports and military noun/adjective for attack; here it means insulting.

definition: long strong pieces of wood or metal that support a building
example: The beams, held up by the columns, support and distribute the weight.
exampleEs: Las vigas, que apoyan sobre los pilares, soportan y distribuyen el peso.
cloze: The ____, held up by the columns, support and distribute the weight.
note: Here 'beam' is a building part; it also means a ray of light.

definition: a change of appearance used to hide who or what you are
example: He was not aware that the praise was a satire in disguise.
exampleEs: No fue consciente de que el elogio era una sátira disfrazada.
cloze: He was not aware that the praise was a satire in ____.
note: 'In disguise' is the fixed phrase; do not say 'in a disguise'.

definition: to change your appearance to hide who you are
example: They disguised themselves as fishermen and escaped in a boat.
exampleEs: Ellos se disfrazaron de pescadores y escaparon en una barca.
cloze: They ____ themselves as fishermen and escaped in a boat.
note: Spelling: 'disguise' has a silent 'u' after the 'g'.

definition: kind and generous in the way you treat or judge others
example: Although his intention is charitable, it does more harm than good.
exampleEs: Aunque su intención es caritativa, crea más perjuicios que beneficios.
cloze: Although his intention is ____, it does more harm than good.
note: 'Charitable' can also mean 'non-profit', as in 'charitable foundation'.

definition: a long passage built under the ground or through a hill
example: It takes us five minutes to walk through the tunnel.
exampleEs: Nos toma cinco minutos atravesar caminando el túnel.
cloze: It takes us five minutes to walk through the ____.

definition: a place where people get medical care or advice
example: We took her straight to the clinic as soon as she fainted.
exampleEs: Cuando ella se desmayó, la llevamos directo a la clínica.
cloze: We took her straight to the ____ as soon as she fainted.
note: A 'clinic' is usually small or outpatient; a large hospital is a 'hospital'.

definition: the place where someone lives
example: Let us know if you change your residence.
exampleEs: Avise usted si cambia de domicilio.
cloze: Let us know if you change your ____.

definition: correctly, without making a mistake
example: If I remember rightly, we should turn left at the next corner.
exampleEs: Si recuerdo correctamente, deberíamos girar a la izquierda en la esquina que viene.
cloze: If I remember ____, we should turn left at the next corner.
note: 'If I remember rightly' is British; most speakers say 'if I remember correctly'.

definition: not true or not right
example: Mark incorrect answers with a red circle before returning the corrected exams to the students.
exampleEs: Rodea las respuestas incorrectas con un círculo rojo antes de devolverles los exámenes corregidos a los alumnos.
cloze: Mark ____ answers with a red circle before returning the corrected exams to the students.

definition: the colored liquid used for writing, printing or cooking
example: Black rice has that color because squid ink is put on it.
exampleEs: El arroz negro tiene ese color porque se le echa tinta de calamar.
cloze: Black rice has that color because squid ____ is put on it.
note: Pronounced /ɪŋk/, with a short 'i'; do not say 'eenk'.

definition: a newspaper article that gives the opinion of the editors
example: Did you read the editorial I wrote for the newspaper?
exampleEs: ¿Leíste el editorial que escribí para el periódico?
cloze: Did you read the ____ I wrote for the newspaper?
note: A false friend: 'editorial' is an opinion article, while a publishing house is a 'publisher'.

definition: to hide something so that nobody can see or find it
example: He is in love with her, but he tries to conceal his feelings.
exampleEs: Está enamorado de ella pero intenta ocultar sus sentimientos.
cloze: He is in love with her, but he tries to ____ his feelings.
note: Spelling: 'conceal' has 'ea', and it is more formal than 'hide'.

definition: a room where scientists do tests and experiments
example: The lack of light and color contributed to the creation of a miserable atmosphere in the lab.
exampleEs: La ausencia de luz y color contribuía a crear un ambiente miserable en el laboratorio.
cloze: The lack of light and color contributed to the creation of a miserable atmosphere in the ____.
note: 'Lab' is short for laboratory; stress is on the first syllable of 'laboratory' in US English.

definition: successful and having a lot of money
example: A prosperous country always needs a stable, capable government.
exampleEs: Un país próspero siempre necesita un gobierno estable y capaz.
cloze: A ____ country always needs a stable, capable government.

definition: a person whose job is to teach a skill or sport
example: At the present time, she is a yoga instructor.
exampleEs: Ahora mismo es profesora de yoga.
cloze: At the present time, she is a yoga ____.

definition: to tell someone officially what they must do
example: He instructed me to go to bed early.
exampleEs: Él me ordenó que me fuera temprano a la cama.
cloze: He ____ me to go to bed early.
note: Pattern: 'instruct someone to do something'; it is not used with 'that' like Spanish 'ordenar que'.

definition: to bring different parts together to form one whole
example: We need a new director to unify our company.
exampleEs: Necesitamos un nuevo director para unificar nuestra compañía.
cloze: We need a new director to ____ our company.

definition: words copied exactly from a speaker or text
example: You should put quotation marks around this phrase.
exampleEs: Deberías poner comilas alrededor de esta frase.
cloze: You should put ____ marks around this phrase.
note: In English, quotation marks are comillas; a price quotation is also a cotización.

definition: a sudden, powerful explosion of air or gas
example: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
exampleEs: Una serie de explosiones dejó el laboratorio en ruinas.
cloze: A series of ____ reduced the laboratory to ruins.

definition: to say what you know in a court of law
example: All of them testified in favor of the accused.
exampleEs: Todos ellos testificaron a favor del acusado.
cloze: All of them ____ in favor of the accused.
note: Spanish 'testificar' matches, but use 'testify in favor of / against' with prepositions.

definition: continuing for a long time without stopping
example: Have you had any persistent itching, rash, or dryness anywhere on your body?
exampleEs: ¿Has tenido picazón, erupciones o sequedad en alguna parte del cuerpo?
cloze: Have you had any ____ itching, rash, or dryness anywhere on your body?

definition: to become larger and rounder because of injury or fluid
example: Are your ankles swollen when you wake up in the morning?
exampleEs: ¿Tienes los tobillos hinchados cuando te levantas por la mañana?
cloze: Are your ankles ____ when you wake up in the morning?
note: The past participle is swollen (not swelled) when used as an adjective.

definition: deserving respect, attention or a particular honor
example: He is a poet worthy of the title.
exampleEs: Es un poeta digno de ese apelativo.
cloze: He is a poet ____ of the title.
note: Say 'worthy of' + noun; do not use 'worthy to' or 'worthy for'.

definition: a person trained and licensed to treat sick people
example: The word doctor refers to a person with the highest university degree, and colloquially to a physician.
exampleEs: La palabra doctor hace referencia a una persona con la máxima titulación académica y coloquialmente a un médico.
cloze: The word doctor refers to a person with the highest university degree, and colloquially to a ____.
note: A physician is a medical doctor; 'physicist' is a different word (físico).

definition: people whose job is to write computer software
example: Even though computer programmers may use semicolons every day, nowadays most people only use semicolons for emoticons.
exampleEs: Aunque los programadores utilizan a diario el punto y coma, actualmente la mayoría de las personas usan el punto y coma sólo para los emoticones.
cloze: Even though computer ____ may use semicolons every day, nowadays most people only use semicolons for emoticons.

definition: in a way that surprises you because you did not expect it
example: One morning, she unexpectedly met him on the street.
exampleEs: Una mañana ella se lo encontró inesperadamente en la calle.
cloze: One morning, she ____ met him on the street.

definition: during the recent past, up to now
example: I haven't had any time to read books lately.
exampleEs: Últimamente no he tenido nada de tiempo para leer libros.
cloze: I haven't had any time to read books ____.
note: Use lately with present perfect or negatives; do not confuse it with 'late' (tarde).

definition: relating to a country that rules another territory
example: There was little colonial presence in that country.
exampleEs: En aquel país hubo escasa presencia colonial.
cloze: There was little ____ presence in that country.

definition: an official document that lets you travel to other countries
example: What's the best way for me to get a passport?
exampleEs: ¿Cuál es la mejor manera de obtener un pasaporte?
cloze: What's the best way for me to get a ____?

definition: to a very serious or extreme degree
example: All life support systems have been severely damaged.
exampleEs: Todos los sistemas de soporte vital han sido gravemente dañados.
cloze: All life support systems have been ____ damaged.

definition: serious and unhappy, suggesting bad news
example: From the doctor's grim expression, it was clear he had somber news for the patient.
exampleEs: De la expresión siniestra del doctor, estaba claro que tenía noticias sombrías para el paciente.
cloze: From the doctor's ____ expression, it was clear he had somber news for the patient.
note: Not 'grima'; grim means serious or gloomy, not disgusting.

definition: a neat pile of things placed one on top of another
example: There was a stack of newspapers in the corner of the room.
exampleEs: Había una pila de periódicos en la esquina de la pieza.
cloze: There was a ____ of newspapers in the corner of the room.

definition: instructions for preparing a particular food dish
example: I have more than two hundred recipes in that notebook.
exampleEs: Tengo más de doscientas recetas en aquel cuaderno.
cloze: I have more than two hundred ____ in that notebook.
note: Pronounced REH-suh-pee, with three syllables.

definition: the story of a person's life written by someone else
example: I have no interest whatsoever in reading his biography.
exampleEs: No tengo ningún interés en leer su biografía.
cloze: I have no interest whatsoever in reading his ____.

definition: relating to a number that identifies one product
example: The model and serial numbers are located on the bottom of the console.
exampleEs: El modelo y los números de serie están localizados en el fondo de la consola.
cloze: The model and ____ numbers are located on the bottom of the console.
note: Serial is not 'cereal'; cereal is a breakfast food and sounds almost the same.

definition: having the power to attract iron or steel
example: An electric current can generate a magnetic field.
exampleEs: Una corriente eléctrica puede generar un campo magnético.
cloze: An electric current can generate a ____ field.

definition: a general trend or direction of opinion or events
example: The tide of public opinion is turning against sexism.
exampleEs: La corriente de opinión pública se está inclinando en contra del sexismo.
cloze: The ____ of public opinion is turning against sexism.

definition: to refuse openly to obey or accept someone or something
example: We defy our foes, for our passion makes us strong!
exampleEs: ¡Desafiamos a nuestros enemigos porque nuestra pasión nos hace fuertes!
cloze: We ____ our foes, for our passion makes us strong!
